text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, Oguri Cap calls me to the dance studio.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You came…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I came up with some choreography during my dance lesson, but I can't figure out what to do for the chorus.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'll show you what I've come up with so far, so please give me your honest opinion.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: How was it?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oguri-ness? Yeah, maybe that is what's missing.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the advice. So… What do you think I should do?
choice_data_list: Do you have a favorite dance move?
Do you have a favorite dance move?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …Actually, I do. It's called the banana dance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I search for "banana dance" online, and a video of people dancing in festival coats comes up.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah. We'd do this dance at our festivals back home.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Every time I watch them all dancing to the festival music, it cheers me up.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: It might be a little unconventional for a winning concert, but I really like this dance.
choice_data_list: Why not incorporate a few of its elements?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Good idea! Okay, show me that clip again.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Which part do you like? I'll try and incorporate it into my choreography.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You're right… Seeing them move like that is super energizing.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I like how they move after hitting the taiko drums as well. Maybe if we combine the two…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Okay, that's perfect. All that's left for me to do now is practice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When Oguri Cap shows off her perfected choreography, she captivates everybody watching with her forceful movements.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah… It's hard to take your eyes off them.

text_block_list.text: I like how they move after hitting the taiko drums as well. Maybe if we combine the two…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Okay, that's perfect. All that's left for me to do now is practice.

text_block_list.text: When Oguri Cap shows off her perfected choreography, she captivates everybody watching with her graceful movements.
